profile_format: one KW UserProfile JSON object per JSONL line

source.name: ESCO
source.license_and_attribution: ESCO v1.2.1; European Commission reuse conditions (2011/833/EU). ESCO acknowledgement required.

generation_method: Uniformly sample an occupation with essential skill relationships; select 1-20 essential skills, 0-3 optional skills, and 0-2 skills from the full ESCO skill catalog that are not linked to that target occupation. Proficiency and non-skill profile fields are left unknown or empty.
limitations: All profiles and target-role labels are synthetic and are not real users, self-reports, observed career outcomes, or representative population samples.
Synthetic target occupations are evaluation labels only and are stored separately from the KW UserProfile contract.
ESCO occupation-skill relationships are classification data, not job vacancy, employer demand, or hiring evidence.
